turn.say: NakhlaID says NID-423 when I try to sign in. What should I do?

turns.reply: The error code NID-423 means your NakhlaID account is locked due to 5 failed sign-in attempts within 15 minutes. To resolve this, you can either wait 30 minutes for the lock to release automatically or unlock it immediately by visiting https://id.nakhla.example/unlock, entering your work email, and approving the NakhlaKey prompt or using a backup code. This unlock process does not change your password. If you have forgotten your password, you should reset it instead at https://id.nakhla.example/reset. Avoid asking the Service Desk to unlock or reset your account over phone, chat, or email, as they cannot perform these actions. [SP-001] [KB-006] [KB-004]

turn.say: My NakhlaConnect VPN shows NX-112 since this morning. I work from home.

turns.reply: The VPN error code NX-112 means the device certificate is missing or expired, typically because the device is not compliant or has been offline for more than 30 days. The fix is to open NakhlaManage, perform a Sync, then restart the laptop and ensure the device is compliant as per compliance rules. A non-compliant laptop loses its device certificate, causing NX-112. This is documented in KB-002 and KB-010. [KB-002] [KB-010]

turn.say: I did all of that: NakhlaManage Sync, restarted the laptop, and NakhlaManage says the laptop is compliant. It still shows NX-112 and I cannot work. Please open a ticket.

turns.reply:
Only company devices enrolled in NakhlaManage and compliant may use NakhlaConnect VPN; a non-compliant laptop loses its device certificate causing NX-112 error. The fix is to sync NakhlaManage and restart the laptop to restore compliance and the certificate. If these steps fail, the Service Desk opens a ticket with category 'network_access' and priority P2 for a single user blocked from VPN access. The Support department follows standard priority rules, with P2 for one user blocked and no immediate escalation required. [SP-002] [KB-002] [KB-016] [KB-015]
Review this exact ticket draft, then approve or reject it.

turn.say: NakhlaID says NID-423 when I try to sign in. What should I do?

turns.reply: The error code NID-423 means your NakhlaID account is locked due to 5 failed sign-in attempts within 15 minutes. To resolve this, you can either wait 30 minutes for the lock to release automatically or unlock it immediately by visiting https://id.nakhla.example/unlock, entering your work email, and approving the NakhlaKey prompt or using a backup code. This unlock process does not change your password. If you have forgotten your password, you should reset it instead at https://id.nakhla.example/reset. Repeated lockouts may indicate an old password saved on a device; update or remove old passwords from all devices to prevent further lockouts. [SP-001] [KB-006] [KB-004]

The fix is to open NakhlaManage, perform a Sync, then restart the laptop and ensure the device is compliant as per compliance rules. A non-compliant laptop loses its device certificate after 24 hours, causing NX-112. This is documented in KB-002 and KB-010. [KB-002] [KB-010]
